handoff.summary: evals extraction: socom cycle (ledger->cycle measurement spine) + next-session prompt id/timestamp
handoff.done:
Two increments, all gates green, pushed to origin/main, CI verified green (run 27480499785 -> success).
1. next-session prompt identity (4181b81, 6af363a): `socom prompt` now stamps every generated prompt with id=P-<date>-<branch> + generated=<ts> + source-handoff, inherited from the handoff (single ordering authority, no second clock). .socom/prompts/ is now tracked. Smoke locks the header. WHY: the session-start drift scan needs a write-time IN the prompt, not git mtime.
2. evals extraction = backlog #1 (c405560, 095a923): the ledger->cycle measurement spine, the first Akili->SOCOM port. - schemas/ledger.xml: append-only JSONL run ledger (.socom/ledger/runs.jsonl), one row per promise execution (seat, promise, contract, gate_band, exit_code, duration_s, attempt, verdict kept|broken). - `socom cycle`: rolls the ledger into a scored cycle — pass@1/pass@k BY SEAT, hotspots, exit-codes, attempts, contract-coverage. Flags --since/--seat/--cycle/--gate --threshold. Read-only, cache-free, degrades loudly with no ledger. - `eval` gate (canon/gates.xml + .socom/canon/gates.xml) bound to checks.eval = `socom cycle --gate --threshold 70`; fails below threshold. - Gate dispatch generalized: unknown gate id -> checks.<id> (so canon can add gates with no new dispatch code); unknown-gate guard kept. - Renamed from the prompt's `socom eval` (collides with the existing L1 retrieval-acceptance gate) to `socom cycle` — operator-ratified.
Contract (all 4 checks PASS, evidence in c405560 [test] block): ledger.xml well-formed; seeded hand-count matches (builder 1/2 & 2/2, reviewer 0/1, pass@1 1/3, pass@k 2/3); gate RED below / PASS above; doctor clean (source=fce8a0829b46), compile idempotent. Full smoke green (9 new cycle/gate assertions). CI green post-push.
handoff.undone: Deliberately deferred (scope discipline — ONE increment): auto-append of ledger rows from gates/closeout (MVP seeds by hand); the full query suite as flags (health/trends/reliability); efficiency/journal-quality metrics; amber-band measurement gating (eval gate is red for testable both-directions). No ledger is wired to write yet — `socom cycle` works but nothing populates .socom/ledger/runs.jsonl in normal operation. That wiring + the lessons bridge are the next session.

Cost a detour this session. - `socom cycle` is built but no ledger is auto-populated yet — it will degrade-loud ("no ledger") until something appends runs. Expected. - Pre-existing uncommitted churn left untouched on purpose: .socom/gates/ breaches.log (amber breach records) and .socom/index/chunks.jsonl — not part of this work; sweep them deliberately or leave for their owner.
